text: 政协第十四届全国委员会第五十六次主席会议24日在京召开。中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁主持并讲话。
text_en: The 56th Chairman's Meeting of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference was held in Beijing on the 24th. Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, presided over the meeting and delivered a speech.
